english_draft: Alphabet published Q2 2026 results on July 22, 2026. Total revenue was $119.8 billion. Revenue increased 24% year over year. Constant currency revenue increased 23%. Google Services revenue was $94.5 billion. Search & other revenue was $63.3 billion. YouTube ads revenue was $11.1 billion. Google Cloud revenue was $24.8 billion. Cloud revenue increased 82%. Total operating income was $40.8 billion. Operating margin was 34%. Operating margin rose 2 points. Other income was $98.0 billion. This gain came mainly from unrealized gains on equity securities. Net income was $112.1 billion. Diluted EPS was $9.11. Net income rose 298%. EPS rose 294%. Google Services operating income was $39.5 billion. Google Cloud operating income was $8.8 billion. Other Bets lost $1.8 billion. Alphabet-level activities lost $5.8 billion. The company raised $49.6 billion in equity in June. It issued $20.3 billion in debt. It set up a $40.0 billion ATM program. It sold no shares under ATM by June 30. The board declared a common dividend of $0.22 per share. There was no Preview article for this quarter. Therefore, this analysis cannot compare actual results with prior expectations. It compares with the prior-year quarter.
